summary: thermal replay --against now resolves exact built-in plan ids or names to the plan itself (same row as --compare), instead of silently rendering an unpriced '<plan> (API)' payg row. Resolution uses the new pricing.LookupPlanExact (exact id/name, case-insensitive, never prefix matching), so --against claude stays a model rate-card lookup and is not captured by claude-pro. Model targeting is unchanged for every value that is not an exact plan id or name. A six-part migration entry and a README note document the change.

cases.evidence: TestLookupPlanExact: plan id, plan name ('Claude Pro ($20)'), case variants and whitespace resolve; 'claude', 'deepseek', 'agy', 'kimi', 'claude-3-5-sonnet' and '' do not (prefix never matches).

cmd/thermal subtest 'replay against plan identifiers resolves to plans' asserts the rendered row for --against claude-pro is byte-identical to --compare claude-pro, output contains no 'claude-pro (API)', and --against claude still renders 'claude (API)'. Manual run shows 'Claude Pro ($20) Sub $20.00 ... UNKNOWN (...)'.

docs/MIGRATION.md gained the six-part entry changed-replay-against-plan-resolution (heading, detection signal, rationale, before/after, fix, escape hatch) and is linked from the table of contents; README documents the plan-id resolution next to the --against examples.
